ferula.definition:
n. A ferule.
n. The imperial scepter in the Byzantine or Eastern Empire.
ferula.translation: n. 阿魏(药用植物), 戒尺, 权杖

ferulaceous.definition:
a. Pertaining to reeds and canes; having a stalk like a
   reed; as, ferulaceous plants.

ferule.definition: n. a switch (a stick or cane or flat paddle) used to punish children
ferule.translation:
n. 戒尺, 管教, (学校的)纪律
vt. 用戒尺责打

feruled.translation: v. 教鞭, 戒尺( ferule的过去式和过去分词 )

ferules.translation: 教鞭, 戒尺( ferule的名词复数 )

ferulic.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or derived from, asafetida (Ferula
   asafoetida); as, ferulic acid.

ferulic acid.translation:
[化] 阿魏酸
[医] 阿魏酸

feruling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Ferule
feruling.translation: v. 教鞭, 戒尺( ferule的现在分词 )
